final_message:
**Status:** Reproduced (simulated Windows' lower open-handle limit by lowering the Linux fd limit)

**Expected:** `eslint . --fix` writes the fixes for every file that has auto-fixable problems and exits normally.

**Actual:** The run aborts with `EMFILE: too many open files, open '<file>'`. The stack matches the report: `fs.writeFile` -> `Promise.all (index N)` -> `ESLint.outputFixes (lib/eslint/eslint.js:533)` -> `cli.js:637`. ESLint exits with code 2. Fixes are only partly written (1003 of 3000 files in the 3000-file case).

**Trigger:** The number of files with fixes exceeds the process's open-file limit. With `ulimit -n 1024`, 1000 files pass and 1100 fail. Each file has one `prefer-const` fix. I also hit it with the default limit here (20000) by using 22000 files. The reporter's Windows limit (~8192 handles, their failing index was 8189) can't be matched on this machine, which is why the status says simulated.

**Run:** `bash repro-emfile.sh 3000 1024`

**Reliability:** Deterministic. 3/3 runs at 3000 files failed, and every size at or above 1100 files with the 1024 limit failed. 500, 800 and 1000 files pass at the same limit.

**Artifacts:** `/work/runs/784f28b00c/repo/repro-emfile.sh`. It builds N files in a temp dir, runs `bin/eslint.js . --fix` under the chosen `ulimit -n`, then prints the exit code and how many files were actually fixed.

No production code was changed.

Likely cause: `ESLint.outputFixes` (lib/eslint/eslint.js:533-545) runs `Promise.all(results.map(r => fs.writeFile(...)))` with no concurrency limit. Every `open` is queued before any `write` or `close` completes, so all the file handles are open at once.
patch:
diff --git a/repro-emfile.sh b/repro-emfile.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..6dab93b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro-emfile.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Reproduction for "eslint --fix throws EMFILE: too many open files".
+# ESLint.outputFixes() does Promise.all(results.map(r => fs.writeFile(...))) with no
+# concurrency limit, so every file handle is opened before any is closed.
+# Run from the repo root:  bash repro-emfile.sh [FILE_COUNT] [FD_LIMIT]
+set -u
+N="${1:-3000}"
+LIMIT="${2:-1024}"          # common default `ulimit -n` on Linux
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
+DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
+trap 'rm -rf "$DIR"' EXIT
+cd "$DIR"
+echo 'module.exports = [{ rules: { "prefer-const": "error" } }];' > eslint.config.js
+for i in $(seq 1 "$N"); do printf 'let a = 1;\nconsole.log(a);\n' > "f$i.js"; done
+ulimit -n "$LIMIT"
+node "$ROOT/bin/eslint.js" . --fix
+code=$?
+fixed=$(grep -l '^const a' f*.js 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
+echo "eslint exit code: $code; files actually fixed: $fixed / $N (fd limit $LIMIT)"
+exit "$code"
